items.title: さらば嵐よ。
items.sourceType: 海外Redditフォーラム 鳴潮総合 (公式純リンクRSS)
items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
It was a great journey, since the beginning of the game.  But it has finally come to this day where I can't play anymore. My phone has barely any space left and irl, I am having troubles keeping up with games at all. I hope best for Wuwa, may it succeed in the upcoming future, as it always does. I planned on playing till getting Hsin, but it seems like, I can't until I get a new pc that would take a few months. Thank you for the memories, Wuwa. I love you Hsin! 😢😢 I WILL RETURN FOR YOU!     submitted by    /u/Sensitive-Slide-2437   [link]   [個のコメント]
